summary: The MS is for CSB PhD students who have finished the first two years of coursework: the listed required courses (with CSB 270 in the fall, winter and spring of years one and two), one chemical biology course, two CSB electives and one more elective, for 45 units in all. Each of these courses must be letter graded with a B- or better when a letter grade is offered; courses offered only S/NC, like CSB 399 research, count as they are. An elective the Student Advisory Committee approves, or a writing course in place of BIOS 263 once you hold a fellowship, is moved in by hand. You check by hand the qualifying exam and the written thesis.

xe9iFJMC.why: Grading: "Normally, if a course has the option to be taken as a letter grade, the student must take the course as a letter grade and receive a B- or better to have the course count towards the CSB PhD requirements." It is on the course rules, not the program, so S/NC and lower-graded units still count toward the 45.
